tasks.label: git-log-check
tasks.command: cd /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I && (command -v dtc || true; grep -oba $'\xd0\x0d\xfe\xed' /tmp/cb1-p1.img | sed -n '1,40p'; OFF=$(grep -oba $'\xd0\x0d\xfe\xed' /tmp/cb1-p1.img | head -n1 | cut -d: -f1); echo "OFF=$OFF"; if [ -n "$OFF" ]; then SZHEX=$(dd if=/tmp/cb1-p1.img bs=1 skip=$((OFF+4)) count=4 status=none | od -An -tx4 | tr -d ' '); SZ=$((16#$SZHEX)); echo "SZHEX=$SZHEX SZ=$SZ"; dd if=/tmp/cb1-p1.img of=/tmp/vendor-first.dtb bs=1 skip=${OFF} count=${SZ} status=none; file /tmp/vendor-first.dtb; strings /tmp/vendor-first.dtb | grep -Ei 'bigtreetech|cb1|pad7|hdmi|dsi|lt8619|vibration' | sed -n '1,120p'; if command -v dtc >/dev/null 2>&1; then dtc -I dtb -O dts -o /tmp/vendor-first.dts /tmp/vendor-first.dtb >/tmp/dtc.out 2>&1 || true; sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/dtc.out; grep -Ein 'bigtreetech|pad7|hdmi|dsi|lt8619|vibration|display' /tmp/vendor-first.dts | sed -n '1,220p'; fi; fi) 2>&1 | tee /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I/.vscode/new_job.txt

tasks.label: git-push-ci-fixes
tasks.command: ( cd /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I && git add build/build.sh build/mkimage.sh config/uboot/armbianEnv.txt boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf && git commit -m 'fix: boot with upstream bigtreetech-pi DTB for vendor-baseline display test' && git push origin HEAD:Default ) 2>&1 | tee /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I/.vscode/new_job.txt
